workflow.asic.description: Run a pinned ASIC implementation and verification plan; completion requires every applicable configured check and complete evidence.

workflow.analog.description: Generate/netlist, simulate, characterize, verify physical views, and optionally compare extracted behavior according to the saved plan.

workflow.photonic.description: Run a saved photonic construction, circuit response, geometry verification, and qualified device-solver plan.

check.syntax.description: Parse and lint the selected source language and supported language subset.

check.connectivity.description: Check canonical circuit connectivity and interface mappings.

check.erc.description: Apply electrical rules to circuit participants and declared electrical semantics.

check.drc.description: Check physical geometry against the selected pinned technology rule deck.

check.lvs.description: Compare independently selected layout extraction and reference circuit netlists.

check.antenna.description: Check process antenna ratios and routing antenna properties.

check.view_sync.description: Compare selected source/native/extracted views using canonical identity and pin mappings.

check.layout_xor.description: Compare two layout stream-outs using geometric XOR.

check.formal.description: Prove, bound, or cover formal properties, preserving assumptions, bounds, solver status, and counterexamples.

check.equivalence.description: Compare golden and candidate implementations under explicit mapping and assumptions.

check.mutation.description: Evaluate test/property effectiveness against controlled source mutations.

simulate.spice.description: Run the explicitly selected SPICE analysis with compatible circuit/model views; every mode is qualified separately per backend and device model.

simulate.hdl.description: Compile/elaborate and simulate the canvas-selected HDL language using an HDL bench or qualified Python cocotb test source.

simulate.cosim.description: Run the selected analog/digital coupling contract. A sampled one-way handoff and a live feedback solver are distinct qualified coupling capabilities.

simulate.optical.description: Simulate a circuit using calibrated optical/mixed-domain compact models; advertise each model and analysis compatibility independently.

synthesize.hdl.description: Elaborate the canvas-selected HDL/frontend and synthesize a logic netlist, optionally mapping into a pinned standard-cell library.

implement.asic.description: Run a full qualified ASIC flow or a registered stage from a pinned compatible prior state.

implement.fpga.description: Perform synthesis/place-and-route and architecture-specific bitstream generation for an explicitly qualified FPGA device; programming is outside this task.

analyze.timing.description: Perform static timing with explicit clocks, constraints, libraries, corners and optional extracted RC; report missing constraints and coverage.

analyze.power.description: Estimate characterized digital power or calculate a qualified physical IR-drop study from declared activity and supplies.

analyze.measurements.description: Evaluate saved measurements, spectra/FFT, comparisons and plots against pinned result artifacts and measurement definitions.

extract.layout.description: Extract devices/circuit connectivity or parasitic RC from a selected physical view using a compatible technology/extraction deck.

characterize.circuit.description: Repeat supported simulations across explicit parameter/corner/statistical samples and evaluate a saved characterization specification.

simulate.em.description: Solve a saved physical field study with explicit geometry, materials, ports, boundaries, mesh and convergence settings; electromagnetic compliance requires its own modeled limits.

simulate.thermal.description: Solve a saved thermal study with explicit materials, power sources, boundaries and mesh; coupled electrothermal behavior requires a separately qualified study.

simulate.device.description: Solve declared semiconductor-device equations and physical boundary conditions in a saved qualified DEVSIM study.

generate.views.description: Generate selected component views from pinned sources/factories, producing candidate artifacts and canonical mappings; project adoption uses the shared revision-checked edit contract.

generate.netlist.description: Emit a circuit netlist for the selected schematic/component closure with explicit canonical-to-native terminal ordering.

export.design.description: Export a pinned design view or project bundle, retaining supported native properties and reporting any lossy conversion.

compile.model.description: Compile a pinned Verilog-A source closure into a compatible OSDI model artifact in the isolated worker.
